description: FTL: Faster Than Light Advanced Edition (native Linux, GOG v1.6.12)
long: FTL: Faster Than Light is a spaceship-management roguelike in which the player captains a vessel fleeing across the galaxy while carrying critical information, managing power, crew and systems through real-time tactical encounters. Each run is procedurally generated, with permanent death and branching event choices. This is the free Advanced Edition content update, run as a native Linux build from GOG.
name: FTL: Faster Than Light Advanced Edition
